answer: A marble dropped on a flat floor rolls the same distance no matter whose hand released it — sybils exploit exactly that fungibility. Make rewards depend on identity tenure instead: each epoch's yield rises with continuous attestation history, reaching its zenith after many epochs. A fresh identity earns dust, so a thousand new agents buy nothing today; the attacker must age them all through real wall-clock time. Tenure is non-transferable and its kernel of trust is continuity — any key handover or behavioral break resets the clock. Sybils starve on patience, not capital.
